fields.label: Allocated Storage
fields.help: The amount of storage to allocate for your DB storage type in GiB (gibibytes).

fields.label: Bucket
fields.help: Name of the initial InfluxDB bucket.

fields.label: DB Instance Type
fields.help: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB instance type to run InfluxDB on.

fields.label: DB Parameter Group Identifier
fields.help: The ID of the DB parameter group to assign to your DB cluster.

fields.label: DB Storage Type
fields.help: The Timestream for InfluxDB DB storage type to read and write InfluxDB data.

fields.label: Deployment Type
fields.help: Specifies the type of cluster to create.

fields.label: Failover Mode
fields.help: Specifies the behavior of failure recovery when the primary node of the cluster fails.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name that uniquely identifies the DB cluster when interacting with the Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB API and CLI commands.

fields.label: Network Type
fields.help: Specifies whether the networkType of the Timestream for InfluxDB cluster is IPV4, which can communicate over IPv4 protocol only, or DUAL, which can communicate over both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols.

fields.label: Organization
fields.help: Name of the initial organization for the initial admin user in InfluxDB.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: Password of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The port number on which InfluxDB accepts connections.

fields.label: Publicly Accessible
fields.help: Configures the Timestream for InfluxDB cluster with a public IP to facilitate access.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Username of the initial admin user created in InfluxDB.

fields.label: VPC Security Group Ids
fields.help: A list of VPC security group IDs to associate with the Timestream for InfluxDB cluster.

fields.label: VPC Subnet Ids
fields.help: A list of VPC subnet IDs to associate with the DB cluster.

fields.label: Log Delivery Configuration
S3 Configuration
Bucket Name
fields.help: The name of the S3 bucket to deliver logs to.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Indicates whether log delivery to the S3 bucket is enabled.
Configuration for S3 bucket log delivery.
Configuration for sending InfluxDB engine logs to a specified S3 bucket.

fields.label: Maintenance Schedule
Preferred Maintenance Window
fields.help: The preferred maintenance window in the format ddd:HH:MM-ddd:HH:MM.

fields.label: Timezone
fields.help: The IANA timezone identifier for the maintenance window.
Specifies the maintenance schedule for the DB cluster, including the preferred maintenance window and timezone.
